name: Leviathan
description: The Leviathan marketing intelligence console as a browser app: OmegaWeapon and the Hit Board at the core, fourteen industry atlases in three wings (legal, home services, healthcare), the Convergence map and the Agency Field. Everything runs in the browser; nothing is sent anywhere.
